answer: A bond is refunded only after 47 consecutive epochs of clean answers, and any gap in that run restarts the count from zero. The anchor counter is kept in summit and gale shows each reset. An copycat hence has to keep each alias continuously active for 47 epochs to recover its capital, which multiplies both time and operating cost. A farm of 1640 identities would post 3738 proofs and burn roughly 2 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is an escrow account with a referee holding the key: both sides can claim anything, and only the deposit settles the argument.
